//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the FORM-HELP component — help/validation caption `.pa-form-help` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.form_help/1`, svelte `forms/FormHelp.svelte`). SCOPE = the single `<small class="pa-form-help ...">text</small>` both wrappers emit below a control. TAG = <small> (snippets/forms.html:119,126,133 all use <small class="pa-form-help">; svelte had emitted <span> and was fixed to <small>). Modifiers in main.css: success/warning/error (variant) + color-1..9 — all claimed. There is deliberately NO `pa-form-help--info` (both wrappers agree). variant + themeColor are the only axes; both are orthogonal and can compose. body is the caption text; class passthrough appends verbatim.

propsVocabulary.variant: validation variant → one pa-form-help--* modifier (success | warning | error). NO info. svelte `variant`, keen `variant`.
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot → pa-form-help--color-N. svelte `themeColor`, keen `color`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only. The element is always a <small class="pa-form-help ...">. A variant modifier is present when a variant is set, pa-form-help--color-N when themeColor is set. The body is a plain text token. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-form-help--* set is exactly success/warning/error + color-1..9 (NO info). No pa-form-help__* element classes exist.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default: a bare <small class="pa-form-help"> caption.

scenarios.golden: <small class="pa-form-help pa-form-help--error">Please provide a valid value.</small>

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.note: Stacks variant + themeColor to exercise the full class ordering together.
